overview: A Hundred Percent is about a group of friends working inside the Thought Leader industrial complex. Their books, podcasts and morning routines might help us live our lives more perfectly, but away from the screens and mics, they are most definitely far from perfect.
title: A Hundred Percent

overview: Daracha is a 35-year-old woman who is well educated and has a simple life with a set routine. After the failure of her first love, she has never opened up her heart to anyone. That is, until one day Wayu arrives into her world. The younger man is in his late twenties but loves to live his life freely, without the restrictions of a nine to five job and other societal expectations. Despite being so different from each other, the two fall in love and are happy. However, everyone around Daracha considers this relationship to be unacceptable as Wayu does not have a stable job like her and spends his life only for today without planning for the future or taking quick actions when problems arise. Wayu slowly realises how different the two of them are, and the feelings of uncertainty begin to grow bigger when one day Daracha's first love, Songwat, arrives and begins to influence their life. Suddenly it is time Daracha makes a decision for the future
title: Something in the Wind

overview: Palermo, 1897. At the inauguration of the exhibition of new technologies, an unstoppable fire causes many victims and forever upsets the destinies of three women: Arianna, Costanza and Rosalia. A costume drama, which still represents current issues. The protagonists fight for their own salvation from a destiny that seems already sealed, stubbornly striving for their own emancipation and achievement of happiness.
title: Più forti del destino

overview: Seo Mi-rae is worn out by work. Love? It's the last thing on her mind. But a virtual dating service sparks feelings - and maybe a real shot at romance.
title: Boyfriend on Demand

overview: Italy, late 60s. In order to save her family from poverty, Maria, a Calabrian woman, accepts to marry Italo, nephew of a rough farmer living in Vicenza.
title: La Sposa

overview: Prithvi Vallabh is a tale of two powerful states constantly at war. Mrinal of Manyakheta dynasty nursed an enmity against Malwa since childhood as they were responsible for her parents' death. The battle brings two warring souls; Mrinal and Prithvi face to face. The animosity leads to deception, and rejection that gradually transcends into a heart rending passionate love story- a love story that perhaps was never meant to be. Here is a unique story that starts with hatred in a battlefield and ends up becoming the biggest love story, one that has never been told before.
title: Prithvi Vallabh: Itihaas Bhi, Rahasya Bhi

overview: Based on unfinished 1954 novel by the German author Thomas Mann. It is a parody of Goethe's autobiography Poetry and Truth, particularly in its pompous tone. A young man gains social and amorous advantages through deception and his good looks.
title: Bekenntnisse des Hochstaplers Felix Krull

overview: In the 6th century AD, large parts of the world were affected by mysterious weather events causing temperature drop, crop failures and famines. All this might be the result of a large volcanic eruption in the tropics. But can a local natural disaster impact the global weather, thus influencing the course of history? Using stunning re-enactments and unique animation techniques, "The Power of Volcanoes" makes it clear: Volcanoes might be sleeping giants. But they can wake up quicker than you think and in the worst case trigger a fatal chain of events.
title: Schlafende Riesen - Die Macht der Vulkane

overview: A high definition look at some of the world's most interesting insects.
title: Insectia

overview: Robbe and his dog Kosmoo are best friends. When Kosmoo is involved in an accident, he can only be saved by giving him bionic elements. Because of these elements, Kosmoo now has phenomenal powers. A new hero is born.
title: Kosmoo

overview: He is a former criminal. She is a special forces soldier. They have nothing in common except... mutual attraction and a desire to get to the bottom of the truth. However, will they retain the former after learning the latter? The brave fighter against the "criminal element," Veronika Grekova, having become disillusioned with her profession, is seriously considering resigning and settling down for a quiet family life with a balanced, reliable partner. The promising IT specialist, Alexander Demidov, dreams of taking on a major leadership position and marrying his fiancée. Just one call will ruin all their brilliant plans and throw them into a whirlwind of criminal events, the trail of which stretches back into the past.
title: Молодые и злые

overview: This educational experience provides insights into the diameters, orbits, velocities, and temperatures of nine planets and their moons.
title: Tous sur orbite

overview: A stunning ode to the power and majesty of Irish sea cliffs, exploring the intimate relationships they have with the fascinating flora, fauna and the people that call them home. Marine biologist Cormac Mac Fhionnlaoich brings us on a mesmerising tour of the cliffs at Sliabh Liag.
title: Aillte

overview: In Pedra da Lua, a paradisaical city by the sea, the old journalist Álvaro keeps radio 74.5 Uma Onda on the air, radiating hope, humour and high spirits. The starting point is the arrival of Luiza, the radio host's granddaughter, who returns after suffering a severe disappointment in her marriage to Caíque. Starting a new life again, the young woman falls in love with Miguel, an ex-boyfriend who lives on a boat and lives taking tourists out. Miguel is the son of a fisherman and has been passionate about the sea since he was a boy. As a child, he and Luiza dated. They both believe that, in past lives, he would have been a porpoise, and she was a mermaid. For socioeconomic reasons, both had to choose different lives. He got a scholarship and went to study marine biology in the United States; Luiza ended up marrying the ambitious and manipulative Caíque. Unhappy with her marriage and life in the big city, she returns to the paradisaical Pedra da Lua, to look for her grandfather Álvaro, and ends up meeting her old love again.
title: 74.5 Uma Onda no Ar

overview: The Rook follows Myfanwy Thomas, a young woman who wakes up in a London park suffering total amnesia and pursued by shadowy paranormal adversaries. Grappling with supernatural abilities of her own, she must fight to uncover her past and resume her position within Britain's secret service, the Checquy, before the traitors who stole her memory can finish what they started.
title: The Rook

overview: We are in Arezzo, in Tuscany, where Fosca Innocenti lives, an assistant superintendent with a casual beauty and an extraordinary gift. His sense of smell transforms every perceived fragrance into a decisive clue. Around her, we find an almost all female police squad. Provincial stories and related crimes. No mafia, no Camorra. A microworld immersed in nature that in four episodes tells about universal themes through the investigations of our protagonist.
title: Fosca Innocenti

overview: While his parents are on vacation, twelve-year-old Victor Laroche wants to uncover the mystery surrounding the death of a girl who fell over a banister in the same house 20 years earlier. His sisters Cora and Louise help him. Through stories told by an elderly uncle, the father of the girl named Cäcilie, they come across a former friend of Cäcilie's, Friedrich Mörlin. The series title refers to a small leather crocodile that Victor finds in the house during his investigations.
title: Das Haus der Krokodile

overview: A single mother, Caterina, is abandoned by her husband and has to raise her three daughters alone, reorganizing her life by working as a postwoman and starting a new relationship, while her daughters grow up facing their own loves and problems, in an alternation of comedy, drama, and family misunderstandings.
title: Caterina e le sue figlie

overview: Trainer Games chronicles ten elite competitors as they fight their way through treacherous challenges set against stunning backdrops of Mauritius, an island in the Indian Ocean known for its adventure landscapes.
title: Trainer Games

overview: After the internal and violent conflict that comes with the transition from childhood to adolescence, seven intrepid, troubled, and scheming children join their lives when they meet at a mysterious and extraordinary school in Mexico City, commanded by the rigid Director Héctor Manríquez (Rubén Cerda), who suffers from his difficult past and is obsessed with education and discipline to become better.
title: Mocosos Latosos

overview: Reckless is set in Charleston, S.C., where a gorgeous Yankee litigator and a charming southern attorney must hide their intense mutual attraction as a police sex scandal threatens to tear the city apart.
title: Reckless

overview: Around the beginning of 1900's, Jiang Yu met Wu Cai Hong and was attracted by her kindness and beauty. He unwittingly discovered she was the daughter of his enemy, and her father sudden death made him the primary suspect. Their path crossed in an effort to find the truth. The closer they worked together, the deeper their mutual attraction, and the harder they hid their feelings. Will the truth give them the permission to love, or will it be their end?
title: Zhua Zhu Cai Hong De Nan Ren

overview: After escaping from the raid of giant monster Skull Gomora, Riku Asakura and his partner Pega stumbled upon a secret base lay 500m underground. Given the Geed Riser and Ultra Capsules by operating system Rem, he transforms into Ultraman Geed and becomes a hero that his childhood inspired.
title: Ultraman Jîdo

overview: Rose seeks revenge on Choke, who killed her family when she was a child. Unbeknownst to him, she survived. Now, living under a new identity and gifted with visions of the future, she uses her abilities to get close to Choke's brother, Chat.
title: Kuhlab satan

overview: To show gratitude to her adoptive father, Rin Rapee accepts to disguise herself as his real daughter and marry Saran, to keep the promise their fathers had made in the past. Saran is a cold-hearted guy who suffers from his previous love. Although he knows that Rin's adoptive family has deceived him, he does not wish to return his bride, since he gets to know her beauty and kindness. Love slowly grows. But soon their love is tested, when Duangsawad, his ex-lover, returns to him, while Rin also feels guilty with the secret she is hiding from him.
title: Padiwaradda

overview: After being unemployed and abandoned by her boyfriend, He Jia Jia left the urban life for the countryside. He Jia Jia meets Fang Wen Yu, a writer who is the complete opposite of her and learns to find her confidence in happiness and life again
title: Jiajia's Lovely Journey

overview: Exploring toxic female friendship through the lens of a sexy, emotional thriller, Poser centers around two estranged, former best friends. When one of them is given a chance to live the life she's long coveted, and maybe get answers as to why they fell out years ago, she finds herself in a psychological game of revenge, betrayal, and heartbreak — ultimately altering their lives, and those around them, forever.
title: Poser

overview: Diego Mancini is an heart surgeon irreproachable that commits a crime to save his son, being extorted by mob.
title: Fino all'ultimo battito

overview: Work, love, marriage, dreams...Four sisters face the inevitable challenges of life and go through trial and error while searching for their own happiness. What will be the four different happy endings they each reach...
title: Wakakusa Monogatari: Koisuru Shimai to Koisenu Watashi

overview: Set inside the bubble of Silicon Valley, The Audacity takes on the warped dreams, outsized egos, and ethical lapses of the self-styled inventors of the future. In a world of jaded billionaires, psychiatrist-gurus, bio-hacked tech bros, AI labs and disillusioned teens being optimized in elite private schools, an audacious data-mining CEO strives to turn insight and influence into profit and power. The darkly comedic drama confronts reality, privacy, and the delusions fueling our ever-changing world.
title: The Audacity

overview: A serial killer who has the ability to cure all incurable diseases, posing a shocking question that overturns law and common sense and building viewers' anticipation.
title: Bloody Flower

overview: The Soviet Union was not just about the hammer and sickle, the first space flights, "PEACE!LABOR!MAY!", or the arms race. For many, it was a time of youth. The best period in every person's life, when we learned to love, to be friends, to cope with defeats, not to lose our heads from victories, and — not to worry about tomorrow… Host of the program "USSR. The "Quality Mark," the artifacts he found, as well as the witnesses of the Soviet era, will allow us to take a time travel journey and remember how the citizens of the largest country on the planet lived. Learn about the USSR in detail, in black and white and in color, with humor and seriousness — with Ivan Okhlobystin!
title: «СССР. Знак качества» с Иваном Охлобыстиным

overview: Salim, a young Mughal prince falls for a courtesan named Anarkali but things become complicated after he faces opposition from Emperor Akbar, his father.
title: Dastaan-E-Mohabbat: Salim Anarkali

overview: Thousands of years ago, a person, upon seeing a horse, was struck by its beauty, intelligence, and the structure of its back. People fell in love with it and wanted to tame it... Man achieved his goal, but only partially. The horse never loved people, and it still doesn't. This film is a look at the history of the relationship between humans and horses. It's about the main secrets of this noble animal and its greatest misfortune — its closeness to humans...
title: Лошадиная энциклопедия

overview: Ten men staying at a gay nude resort are slowly picked off one by one, leading to paranoia, violence, and a whole lot of bitchiness as the dwindling number of survivors turn on each other.
title: Laid Bare

overview: In the after war years from France to motherland returns a soldier with a name Sergei. Giselle his french love is moving with him too. For Giselle it is hard to get used to the lifestyle of a soviet village but she is trying as hard as she can because of her feelings for him. But on the other hand Sergei is a popular man in the village. His neighbour Klavdia is also in love with him and she is trying to destroy the marriage in any possible way. She makes Sergei fall in love with her sister Olga. Unspeakable passion is happening in the village. Which choice will Sergei make?
title: Я дождусь

overview: The story of the engineers and mechanics behind some of the largest lifting and moving equipment in the world.
title: Heavy Lift

overview: The Ultraman series is about a futuristic policeman who secretly transforms into a giant extraterrestrial savior.
title: Ultraman

overview: Somewhere in the Urals, the small town of gavrilovka was lost. The old house, khrushchovkas, a squatter... Around the river and lake, wonderful places-hunting, fishing, mushrooms and berries. Here people live slowly, everyone knows each other, but even here serious passions are boiling, and why is something out of the ordinary always happening? Each episode begins with an emergency that hits residents from the TV show "Echo of Gavrilovka". And the local police Department has to investigate a variety of cases: someone drowns, someone disappears, or something supernatural happens-a Ghost appears in the town. And although the crimes are sometimes very clever, the police get to the bottom of it.
title: Дело было в Гавриловке

overview: Uncover the extraordinary origins of "ordinary" things – and the moments of inspiration that made them possible.
title: The Lightbulb Moment

overview: Wild Animal Rescue follows international animal welfare organization, Four Paws, on daring and sometimes dangerous rescue missions to give animals a better life.
title: Wild Animal Rescue

overview: When tragedy strikes, the first question on the public's mind is: how and why could that have happened? Sometimes the smallest oversight can lead to the greatest of disasters. Problems often arise from the most unlikely source and the seemingly smallest problem can turn into a massive catastrophe. Whatever the cause, these stories make headlines and the world looks on in horror wondering what went wrong.
title: Blueprint for Disaster

overview: The Russian police department is fighting organized crime in Japan. Major of the Sakhalin prosecutor's office, Alexandra Shevchuk, works in partnership with a Hokkaido police officer — Takuya Minamoto. They solve crimes related to the activities of the Russian mafia on the Japanese islands. Soon, Alexandra and Takuya's working relationship develops into romantic feelings.
title: Полиция Хоккайдо. Русский отдел

overview: In the center of the plot is a young man named Mikhail, who lives in one of the cities located on the territory of the Altai Territory. One day he has to leave his native land and go to Moscow in order to bring his sister Anna a rather large amount of money needed for an urgent surgical operation.
title: Медвежья хватка

overview: Peter is the father of spoiled children and works a boring job,. On top of that, he has to deal with his sister Olga's hopeless relationship. When their absent father unexpectedly shows up, life seems to transform.
title: Ивановы

overview: In each episode, two teams of 2 celebrities challenge each other in a game of Kemps. The goal is simple: assemble 4 identical cards and signal it to your partner without being noticed by the other team!
title: Kem's

overview: A four-part series putting aspiring entrepreneurs to the test. Each week two teams of three wheeler dealers are challenged to make their fortune in a trade that they know nothing about, with only £1,000 to help them on their way.
title: Wheeler Dealers

overview: Rising Star Academy is a dream school for kids hoping to enter the entertainment industry. Its curriculum emphasises music and performance and gives students a foothold in the industry. Their students are elite; this year, only twenty new students are admitted from thousands.
title: Fierce & Furious Academy

overview: Becoming Elephant: The Orphans of Reteti is set in the wild north of Kenya, where a groundbreaking blueprint in conservation is under way. This touching documentary series follows the remarkable journey of orphaned elephants at Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, the first community-owned and -operated elephant sanctuary in Africa. These young elephants, rescued after losing their mothers to accidents, drought, or human-wildlife violence, are raised by Samburu men and women who care for them as their own. They nurture these young elephants with patience, care, and deep ancestral knowledge to get them back on their feet and ready for life in the wild. From tiny calves taking their first bottles from their human carers, to adolescents preparing for release, this series captures the elephants' intimate moments of struggle, healing, and transformation. It also shows how local community members are creating a unique, thoughtful new model of conservation from the ground up.
title: Becoming Elephant: The Orphans Of Reteti

overview: Jamie Oliver shows us how to deliver big, beautiful flavour without the hefty price tag.
title: Jamie's Feasts for a Fiver

overview: When a small-town beauty queen suspects the doctor she has been messaging is not who he says he is, she turns detective to catch one of the UK's most prolific catfish.
title: The Beauty Queen and the Catfish

overview: When Northern Irish showjumper Katie Simpson died unexpectedly in August 2020, the horse community accepted that she had taken her own life. However, a local journalist questioned the official conclusion revealing how a secret investigation ended in a high-stakes murder trial.
title: The Showjumper Murder

overview: This documentary series explores the life and career of paparazzi king Fabrizio Corona, reflecting Italy's recent history of scandals and social change.
title: Fabrizio Corona: Io sono notizia

overview: In the village of Vrakola, nestled in the Tran region, mysterious and unexplainable events unfold. People are found murdered in bizarre ways, while others wake up with peculiar marks on their bodies resembling bird claw prints. A sinister, inhuman force seems to have descended upon the village. Amid the chaos, Emil Slavov, a resident of a nursing home, teams up with border officers Bozhana Gorneva and her colleague Mitko to investigate these chilling occurrences. Their search uncovers long-buried secrets from the past and brings them face-to-face with the "Mamnik" – a demonic bird from Bulgarian folklore. As the darkness deepens, Emil's son, Delyan Slavov, mysteriously vanishes. Joining the fight against the evil are Dana, a vrazhalitsa with mystical knowledge, and Lazar Karaivanov, a platenik – a resurrected soul with unfinished business in the mortal world. Prepare to delve into a world of folklore, mystery, and suspense in this gripping tale of the supernatural!
title: Мамник

overview: A dedicated customs officer and his team take on a notorious smuggler leading a powerful syndicate, but unexpected obstacles threaten their mission.
title: Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web
If Only You Weren't the One

overview: Young lawyers navigate the intense demands of their early careers while dealing with personal dramas and relationships, all during a pivotal time in their professional development.
title: Counsels

overview: Handsome Devil: Charming Killer unravels the story of how Wade Wilson, a 25-year-old Florida man arrested for the brutal murders of two women, unexpectedly became a social media fixation. Wilson's mugshot ignited an online frenzy among people drawn to his "bad boy" bravado, surprising tattoos and seductive smile. Dubbed as the "Deadpool Killer," he became an object of fascination for online fans, even as the details of his crimes grew more disturbing. Through police bodycam footage and chilling first-hand accounts from those closest to the case, the series explores how a man who committed unimaginable violence ended up with a devoted online following.
title: Handsome Devil: Charming Killer

overview: Following the recent success of Accidental Tourist, ITV has commissioned a further three more specials which will see Stephen Mulhern enlist the help of long time friends Ant and Dec in a bid toface more of his fears and phobias in some exciting new destinations.
title: Accidental Tourist

overview: Three awkward high school sophomores stumble through the messy world of teenage romance and identity, learning that sucking at girls is just part of growing up.
title: I Suck At Girls

overview: WWE Ride Along is a new reality series that will feature two WWE Divas or Superstars traveling in cars together.
title: WWE Ride Along

overview: The heroes of the series are residents of the Moscow microdistrict of Cheryomushki, whose personal events are connected with the main events of the capital.
title: Черёмушки

overview: Indomptables is a sweeping family saga with country influences, telling the story of two clans: the highly influential Richer family, owners of Richer Enterprises, led by Philippe, a man admired by all; and the formidable Martineau family, agricultural producers, disliked in the community and led by the gruff Michel. The two patriarchs are about to finalise a major transaction: Richer Enterprises will pass into the hands of the Martineaus. But this long-awaited agreement will be disrupted by a disturbing and unexpected event. From then on, everything is turned upside down for them, as well as for their three respective heirs, who soon find themselves caught in the crossfire of the merciless struggle that this event ignites between the two families. A war without rules or morals will have consequences that no one could have imagined…
title: Indomptables

overview: The series Gomorra - Le Origini explores Pietro Savastano's youth in the 1970s, in a Naples undergoing a transformation, poverty-stricken and plagued by cigarette smuggling. The story begins in 1977 with a very young Pietro, the son of no one, growing up as an adoptive brother in a family in the poorest part of Secondigliano. A street kid, he scrapes by as best he can, dreaming of a well-being that is still denied him. The story unfolds through Pietro's loss of innocence, along with his brothers and lifelong friends, their ambitions, and his first great love, which, like that of every teenager, will be wild and passionate. His encounter with Angelo, known as 'A Sirena,' the regent of Secondigliano, marks his entry into the world of crime. Through violence, alliances, and betrayals, Pietro discovers the price that life takes.
title: Gomorra - Le Origini

overview: Types from Kazan is a two-part documentary film featuring live performances by popular Kazan comedians. In the film, we will talk about the development of the stand-up movement in Tatarstan and the Kazan StandUp club, how it all started and how things are now.
title: Типы с Казани

overview: WWE presents a half-hour variety show Edge and Christian's Show That Totally Reeks of Awesomeness starring the talented duo Edge and Christian, in a series that will take a look back at all the highs and lows of sports-entertainment, while offering a unique and humor filled perspective to the WWE Universe.
title: Edge and Christian's Show That Totally Reeks of Awesomeness

overview: Both family members of Western and Traditional Korean medicine hospitals in Onjeong City have had bad blood towards each other for 30 years due to a misunderstanding. Ju-ah and Hyun-bin, each hailing from rival medical families, spend a drunken night together. They later find themselves reunited in the workplace as boss and employee. Even Ju-ah, who is repulsed by the idea of marriage, eventually falls for Hyun-bin, the guy who liked her and who becomes to the ‘straightforward young man', but their relationship turns things upside down for the families. Eventually, the truth of the ‘runaway incident' from 30 years ago is revealed and the two families barely go into reconciliation mode, and it looked like the grudge might end… but a new crisis awaits them.
title: Recipe for Love

overview: A large-scale historical drama that highlights the great victory of the small nation of Silla, which defeated Goguryeo, Baekje, and even the Tang Dynasty, and completed the unification of the three kingdoms.
title: Munmu

overview: Ra Young, Shin Jae, and Hyun Jin are lawyers at LnJ, a law firm for women who are victims of sexual abuse. Their relationship is well-defined, starting with Shin Jae's leadership as CEO of the firm. Ra Young serves as a messenger, regarded as a celebrity lawyer with outstanding eloquence, while Hyun Jin always rushes to the scene to find out evidence. They start to investigate a sexual abuse case involving underage students, and they confront the challenging situation head-on against the cartel of sexual abuse on digital platforms. As they approach the truth of the case, their lives begin to fall into danger, while their past memories haunt them repeatedly. Will they be able to save the victims and overcome the bruises from their past? It is the perfect time to retrieve their lost honour.
title: Honour

overview: A pair of in-laws, whose constant quarrels have turned affection into animosity, suddenly find themselves responsible for raising their 20-month-old nephew after the unexpected accident of his parents. What follows is a chaotic yet heartwarming romance under one roof.
title: Our Universe

overview: Lorraine Kelly traverses Norway's epic fjords, via majestic mountains and dramatic volcanic islands, embracing the local culture, food and traditions of her northern neighbours along the way.
title: Lorraine Kelly's Norwegian Odyssey

overview: From the Alps to the North Sea, flowing through big cities, dramatic landscapes and romantic valleys - Monty explores extraordinary gardens shaped by the mighty River Rhine.
title: Monty Don's Rhineland Gardens

overview: It's the weirdest and most wonderful competition on television. But is there method behind Taskmaster's madness? Greg Davies and Little Alex Horne reveal all, with the help of some willing victims.
title: Taskmasterclass

overview: David Baddiel hosts the purr-fect combo of kitty cuteness, cat calamity and feline fun, featuring pawesome viral sensations and some famous cat-loving faces.
title: David Baddiel: Cat Man

overview: When Pars discovers his biological father is alive, he is thrust into a new world as the heir of the Akabey family. Leaving behind his impoverished life in Adana, he enters a life of wealth in Istanbul, where he must navigate acceptance from his new family. To end a longstanding feud, he marries Asya, a woman he has never met, despite the lingering memory of Gül, who abandoned him due to his poverty. While Asya loves him unconditionally, Pars is torn between his past and present. As their love is tested, both must confront old wounds, proving that love can heal but also expose the deepest scars.
title: Aşk Yarası

overview: In the winter of the fourth year of Shaojing, Xiao Li rescues Wen Yu, a princess of a fallen kingdom. Love blossoms between them, and he risks everything to help her reclaim her throne. Together, they defeat the traitor Pei Song, and Xiao Li rises from a street rogue to become the King of Wei. But at the height of power, their love is put to the test…
title: The Road to Glory

overview: The lives of four lifelong friends take a dramatic turn following an accidental homicide during a bachelor party. Despite their differences, Benjamin, Marcos, Raymond, and Gabriel have sustained their friendship over many years. Their partners, Trinidad, Josefa, and Maite, significant women in their lives, are also part of this group with decades of shared history. However, the tragic death of a dancer at Raymond's bachelor party will forever alter their destinies, forcing them to navigate the turbulent waters of guilt and the fear of losing the lives they've carefully built.
title: Pacto de Sangre

overview: Have you ever wondered what you might want to do for the rest of your life? Have you thought about your "dream job?" Do you have any idea what it takes to get there? Are you headed in the right direction? Real Life 101 introduces you to real people doing real jobs. From doctors, lawyers and veterinarians to fashion designers, sports trainers, music therapists, to college and professional coaches.
title: Real Life 101
